142:t_010:3.en:
$$レイアム$$
「I never thought even the $$地球連邦軍$$ had gone over to the Empire...」

142:t_010:4.en:
$$オットー$$
「Only some of them. The $$地球連邦$$ has not surrendered to the Empire.」

142:t_010:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Since we failed to crush $$クロノ$$ completely, its power still has an influence on the $$連邦軍$$.」

142:t_010:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Then the people we fought today...」

142:t_010:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Most likely they're men under the sway of $$クロノ$$. They also collaborated with the $$ジェミニス$$, after all.」

142:t_010:8.en:
$$カレン$$
「But we beat the Empire's lackeys...! The Miracle of $$厳島$$ is still alive!」

142:t_010:9.en:
$$五飛$$
「But the Empire's main force is being held in reserve... ...We may have merely been made accomplices in their scheme...」

142:t_010:11.en:
$$五飛$$
「For the Empire, the very point of the operation was probably to make Earthlings fight each other here.」

142:t_010:12.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...This battle... may turn out to hold grave significance for $$新日本$$...」

142:t_011:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Stop, $$ギュネイ$$! Do you think $$ネオ・ジオン$$ has a future after joining hands with the $$サイデリアル$$!?」

142:t_011:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Shut up, $$カミーユ$$! I don't need you to tell me that!」

142:t_011:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Then come with us! You fought us once, so you must know what you should do!」

142:t_011:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I'm sure Colonel $$シャア$$ wants that, too!」

142:t_011:4.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'll surpass that man...! And with that power, the Spacenoids...!」

142:t_011:6.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Get out of my way, $$カミーユ$$! You and $$アムロ・レイ$$ are both my enemies!」

142:t_012:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Damn...! Is this as far as I can go!?」

142:t_012:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Wait, $$ギュネイ$$! I want to talk to you!」

142:t_012:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I have nothing to say to you people! I'm... $$ネオ・ジオン$$!」

142:t_013:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So our words don't reach him...」

142:t_014:0.en:
$$五飛$$
「Good teamwork. With this, we can do it.」

142:t_014:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「This much is no Miracle of $$厳島$$ or anything. It's our real strength!」

142:t_100:0.en:
$$五飛$$
($$ナタク$$... Somewhere in my heart, I must have been looking for a place to die...)

142:t_100:1.en:
$$五飛$$
「But it's different now...! Until peace returns to the world, I will devote this life to fighting!」

142:t_100:2.en:
$$五飛$$
「That is the meaning of my life... the meaning of my fighting...! In other words, justice!」

142:t_101:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Come on, if you're coming! I've got no intention of working any miracles!」

142:t_101:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「It's only natural that you lose to me! I'll beat that into your bones!」

142:t_102:1.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「What's wrong, $$ロジャー$$? The enemy is right in front of you.」

142:t_102:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「No... The true enemy is surely much farther away. Something inside me tells me so.」

142:t_102:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I don't know. But to restore peace to the world, negotiating with that existence will probably be necessary.」

142:t_102:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Until I reach that point, I will fight alongside this $$ビッグオー$$!」

142:t_103:0.en:
$$キリコ$$
($$フィアナ$$... Even in this world where I lost you, I will keep fighting...)

142:t_103:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
(For your wish... for a world without war)

142:t_104:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$アムロ・レイ$$! By defeating you, I'll prove my own strength!」

142:t_104:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'll surpass the Colonel and $$フル・フロンタル$$ too! For the future of $$ネオ・ジオン$$!」

142:t_104:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「If I do, then even $$クェス$$...!」

142:t_104:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So $$シャア$$ really is inside you after all!」

142:t_104:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Wake up, $$ギュネイ$$! As long as you keep chasing his shadow, you can never surpass him!」

142:t_105:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Stop, $$ギュネイ$$! I don't want to fight you!」

142:t_105:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Don't bring your playing-at-friends onto the battlefield! As long as you're one of the Federation, you're my enemy!」

142:t_105:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Damn...! Is fighting the only way!?」

142:t_106:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Come, $$カミーユ$$! For the future of $$ジオン$$, too, I will get my hands on power!」

142:t_106:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You hardhead...! Don't think you can change the world by such means!」

142:t_106:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If it's power you want, I'll take you on! And I'll teach you that such a way is meaningless!」

142:t_106:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Think about what the world needs right now, $$ギュネイ$$!」

142:t_107:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$バナージ$$! Come with me, along with the $$ユニコーン$$!」

142:t_107:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「If $$ラプラスの箱$$ can change the world, then I'll use it for the future of the Spacenoids... of $$ジオン$$!」

142:t_107:3.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「To guide the future of $$ジオン$$ in the right direction, we need that power!」

142:t_107:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That's wrong! Only the power of humanity can change the world!」

142:t_107:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Whatever the Box really is, I won't accept anyone trying to change the world with something like that!」

142:t_108:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Captain...! The friendly units aren't responding to our call for a ceasefire!」

142:t_108:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「Former friendly units! I won't let cowards who sold out to the $$サイデリアル$$ call themselves the $$地球連邦軍$$!」

142:t_108:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「Return fire! We'll settle our own family's mess ourselves!」

142:t_109:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(This is bad... I thought this Battle of $$厳島$$ was merely an operation to rob the Japanese of their pride, but it may mean more than that...)

142:t_109:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(This time the enemy is nothing like $$ギルター$$... If it goes badly, $$新日本$$ will...)

142:t_110:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「Why...! Why do Earthlings have to fight each other at a time like this!」

142:t_110:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「Do you people find this country that much of a nuisance!? Answer me!!」

142:t_111:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
(The war with the $$サイデリアル$$ is about to light a fire between Earth and the colonies again...)

142:t_111:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
($$リリーナ$$... Guide the world...)

142:t_112:0.en:
$n
「If they come at me, I'll crush every one of them...!」

142:t_112:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n...! $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and the Federation are both Earthlings too! This is no time for Earthlings to be fighting each other...」

142:t_112:2.en:
$n
「That's why! That's exactly why we can't lose!」

142:t_112:3.en:
$n
「If we lose, I'm sure this situation will spin out of control...! If that happens, it really will be the end of the Earth!」
